blocks.x: As travel editors, we spend a lot of time testing the best suitcases, backpacks, and accessories, because we know just how much getting your gear there (and back) safely matters. Solgaard is among our favorite luggage brands (as well as Away, Calpak, and Travelpro) for high-quality, long-lasting travel gear. The brand keeps functionality, durability, and sustainability at the forefront of its designs.

Bestsellers like The Carry-On Closet and Check-In Closet, both of which feature a smart built-in shelving system, make staying organized and packing your essentials easier than ever. Whether you’re a chronic overpacker who wants lots of outfit options on deck or a minimalist looking for a lightweight and practical bag, Solgaard has you covered with high-quality luggage that’s built to last. Read on for all the best discounts and promo codes from Solgaard for travelers to use now.
Get 10% off with our exclusive Solgaard discount code

Good news for deal-seeking shoppers: You can save 10% off your purchase at Solgaard by using our exclusive discount code CONDENAST10. This is a great time to save on travel essentials like the Ventura backpack, the Voyager weekender, the Trio hanging toiletry bag, and more. Whether you're refreshing your travel gear or shopping for holiday gifts, now is the time to save big with this limited-time coupon code.
Save up to 60% on time-limited Solgaard deals without a coupon code

If you're preparing for an upcoming trip, check out Solgaard's sale section to save up to 60% off, including best-selling suitcases. Now's the time to save 20% off on select colors of the Carry-On Closet (now $275, was $345), the Carry-On Closet Lite (now $196, was $245), the Compass backpack (now $132, was $165), and more travel essentials. Shoppers can also save on the Voyager weekender right now, which has a unique rollout design that makes unpacking a breeze. Plus, the Solar Boombox is marked down from $225 to just $90. Whether you're shopping for a new suitcase, backpack, toiletry kit, or some packing cubes, make sure to take advantage of this sale for a major discount plus free shipping while it lasts.
Get up to $75 off with Solgaard rewards

Fans of Solgaard can save over time by joining its free reward program. By signing up for Solgaard Global Access, members unlock exclusive perks, early access to sales, and earn 1 point for every $1 spent. There are other ways to collect points too: When you join, you'll earn 100 bonus points, and when your birthday rolls around, you'll receive 150 points. You can also earn a few extra points via social follow—10 points each for a brand follow on X, Facebook, and Instagram. Every 300 points accumulated translates to $15 in rewards to use on future purchases.

As you spend more with the brand, your points earning potential increases. From that start, you'll be an Adventurer, earning one point per dollar spent. After you've spent $900, you'll become a Globetrotter, earning 1.25 points for every $1 spent, and after spending $1,500, you'll become a Global Citizen, earning 1.5 points per $1 spent, and receiving VIP Invites to Solgaard events.
Compare Solgaard’s award-winning bags for the perfect match

Choosing the right luggage for you and your gear isn’t always easy, but Solgaard takes out some of the guesswork. If you’re stuck on which backpack is your perfect match, compare them with Solgaard’s easy-to-use guide to finding the best bag for you. Solgaard compares price points, bag volume, weight, recommended trip length, and special design features to help you decide which makes sense. This way, overpackers, road trippers, and carry-on-only travelers can see which model is right for them.
When does Solgaard have the best deals?

While these promo codes are active through the end of the year, shoppers won’t want to miss out on the best times of year to save big on luggage and travel accessories from Solgaard. You’ll find Solgaard’s markdowns of the year on Black Friday and Cyber Monday each November, with past years' featuring 20% off discounts extending to big-ticket items and bestsellers like The Check-In Closet and up to 40% sitewide.
What to do if your Solgaard discount code isn’t working

If your Solgaard promo code isn't working at checkout, there are a few things you can do. For starters, double check that your code is spelled correctly and that there are no extra spaces or typos. You should also check to make sure the promo code is still active and if there is a minimum spend required to qualify. Another thing worth checking for is that you haven't already used a particular promo code and if it's valid for first-time shoppers only. If your Solgaard coupon still isn't working after checking these details, clear your browser's cache and give the page a refresh. Shoppers can also reach out to Solgaard's customer service for additional support.
